independence_scope.scope_limit: Claims of absence mean absence from the approved, pinned source scope only; they are not claims of global textual absence.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The second child-name oracle should begin a new top-level chunk.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: Hos.1.2-Hos.1.9 is a serial marriage-and-child naming sequence; no pinned Hebrew marker occurs at this seam.
material_seam_challenges.remedy: Keep Hos.1.2-Hos.1.9 intact and express the child episodes as internal structure.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The third child-name oracle warrants a new top-level chunk.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: The sequence remains syntactically and narratively continuous, and no pinned section marker occurs at the seam.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The judgment names and their reversal should remain one top-level unit.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: A WLC-family samekh follows MT Hos.1.9, and local Hos.1.10 begins a marked reversal from repudiation to innumerable restoration.
material_seam_challenges.remedy: Use Hos.1.2-Hos.1.9 and Hos.1.10-Hos.2.1 as separate chunks; a macro parent may join them.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The pursuit of lovers should be split from the enclosing accusation and judgment speech.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: The obstruction and pursuit language is causal continuation within the same direct-address complex, without pinned marker support.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The removal of Baal names should be split from the covenant-restoration sequence.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: No pinned marker occurs at the seam, and the following covenant and betrothal promises continue the same restoration movement.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The disputed Adam/covenant line should form a boundary before the place accusations.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: Lexical or referential uncertainty at Hos.6.7 is a meaning problem, not positive seam evidence; the accusation catalogue proceeds without marker support.
material_seam_challenges.remedy: Keep Hos.6.4-Hos.6.11 intact and retain the Adam question as a meaning-only hold.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: Hos.6.11 begins a bridge unit that should merge across Hos.7.1.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: The WLC-family pe is after Hos.6.11, not before it. The qere/ketiv at Hos.6.10 affects wording and provides no seam vote.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The restoration language requires a cross-chapter unit Hos.6.11-Hos.7.2.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: A WLC-family pe after Hos.6.11 is strong correlated textual evidence for closure. The syntax and temporal relation can cross the boundary without erasing it.
material_seam_challenges.remedy: Use Hos.6.4-Hos.6.11 and Hos.7.1-Hos.7.7; hydrate both sides for interpretation and hold the temporal-syntax question.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: Hos.7.1-Hos.7.2 is a discrete bridge before the court accusation.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: No pinned marker supports the seam, and the exposure of evil continues naturally into the king-and-princes accusation.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The dove simile begins a new top-level unit.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: The unrepentant pride and foreign-policy imagery form a continuous accusation, without marker support at the seam.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: Hos.7.8-Hos.7.16 should remain one undifferentiated chunk.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: A WLC-family samekh follows Hos.7.12, and Hos.7.13 opens with a woe and renewed direct accusation.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The baseline split after sowing/reaping should be retained.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: Hos.8.7-Hos.8.10 continues the swallow/foreign-dependence consequence chain; the three corrective primaries converge against the baseline seam.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The foreign-dependence and cult/law accusations should remain one top-level unit.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: Hos.8.11 resets from foreign hiring and swallowing to multiplied altars, written law, and sacrifice. The qere/ketiv at Hos.8.12 is internal to the latter unit and is not seam authority.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The anguished fertility petition and Gilgal expulsion should remain one chunk.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: Hos.9.15 resets location, accusation, and expulsion language after the petition.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The qere/ketiv-bearing judgment line should close a unit before the trained-heifer image.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: A qere/ketiv pair is a reading issue, not a boundary marker; the judgment and agricultural images continue one accusation-exhortation movement.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The recollection of divine care should be separated from the consequence statement.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: The consequence is rhetorically dependent on the rejected care and return; no pinned marker supports the seam.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The local Hos.11.12-Hos.12.6 material should remain one chunk.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: Local Hos.12.2 opens an explicit rib formula. All corrective primaries support the local seam, but the literary MT coordinate is off by one.
material_seam_challenges.remedy: Use local Hos.11.12-Hos.12.1 = MT Hos.12.1-Hos.12.2 and local Hos.12.2-Hos.12.6 = MT Hos.12.3-Hos.12.7.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The ransom/death taunt should be split from the east-wind and conquest judgment.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: No pinned marker occurs at this seam, and the interpretation and punctuation of Hos.13.14 are contested within the approved evidence.
material_seam_challenges.remedy: Keep Hos.13.12-Hos.13.16 as one lower-confidence chunk pending broader textual and syntactic evidence.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The baseline Hos.4.11-Hos.4.19 unit should remain unsplit.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: All corrective primaries identify a reset from cultic accusation to a direct warning addressed to Judah.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The baseline Hos.8.1-Hos.8.7 unit should remain unsplit.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: All corrective primaries identify a reset from the calf rebuttal to the sow/reap consequence sequence.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The baseline Hos.9.1-Hos.9.9 unit should remain unsplit.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: All corrective primaries identify a reset from festival/exile loss to days-of-reckoning and watchman discourse; a samekh after Hos.9.9 closes the latter.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The baseline local Hos.12.7-Hos.12.14 unit should remain unsplit.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: All corrective primaries identify a reset from prophets/altars to the Jacob-wife and prophet-deliverance parallel.
material_seam_challenges.remedy: Use local Hos.12.7-Hos.12.11 = MT Hos.12.8-Hos.12.12 and local Hos.12.12-Hos.12.14 = MT Hos.12.13-Hos.12.15.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The baseline Hos.13.1-Hos.13.8 unit should remain unsplit.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: All corrective primaries distinguish the vanishing simile sequence from the renewed exodus-knowledge and wilderness-care accusation.

material_seam_challenges.challenged_claim: The baseline Hos.13.9-Hos.13.16 unit should remain unsplit.
material_seam_challenges.counterevidence: All corrective primaries support the seam, and a WLC-family samekh follows Hos.13.11.
material_seam_challenges.remedy: Use Hos.13.9-Hos.13.11 and a held Hos.13.12-Hos.13.16.

required_focus_audit.finding: Hos.1.8-Hos.1.9 completes the third birth/name episode inside Hos.1.2-Hos.1.9. A samekh after MT Hos.1.9 and the judgment-to-restoration reversal support a seam before local Hos.1.10.
required_focus_audit.recommendation: Keep Hos.1.2-Hos.1.9 and Hos.1.10-Hos.2.1 separate; optionally hydrate them under a shared macro parent.

required_focus_audit.finding: The divine withdrawal, human return speech, and divine critique reset voice and form at Hos.6.1 and Hos.6.4.
required_focus_audit.recommendation: Retain Hos.5.8-Hos.5.15, Hos.6.1-Hos.6.3, and Hos.6.4-Hos.6.11. Hold the sincerity or adequacy of Hos.6.1-Hos.6.3 as meaning, not boundary.

required_focus_audit.finding: A pe follows Hos.6.11 in the correlated WLC witnesses. It outweighs the proposed cross-chapter merge as boundary evidence, though syntax and temporal relations cross the seam.
required_focus_audit.recommendation: Use Hos.6.4-Hos.6.11 and Hos.7.1-Hos.7.7 with mandatory cross-boundary hydration; retain a syntax/meaning hold.

required_focus_audit.finding: The reckoning, watchman, and Gibeah material forms a compact unit closed by a samekh after Hos.9.9.
required_focus_audit.recommendation: Keep Hos.9.7-Hos.9.9 intact; hold speaker/watchman identification as meaning-only.

required_focus_audit.finding: The explicit rib formula at local Hos.12.2 supports a seam after local Hos.12.1. The literary primary's copied local MT spans are invalid.
required_focus_audit.recommendation: Use local Hos.11.12-Hos.12.1 = MT Hos.12.1-Hos.12.2 and local Hos.12.2-Hos.12.6 = MT Hos.12.3-Hos.12.7.

required_focus_audit.finding: Local Hos.13.16 is MT Hos.14.1 and remains inside the judgment sequence; a pe after that MT verse supports the seam before local Hos.14.1 = MT Hos.14.2. No pinned marker supports local Hos.13.14|Hos.13.15.
required_focus_audit.recommendation: Keep local Hos.13.12-Hos.13.16 = MT Hos.13.12-Hos.14.1 as one lower-confidence held chunk, followed by local Hos.14.1-Hos.14.3 = MT Hos.14.2-Hos.14.4.

required_focus_audit.finding: Local Hos.14.9 is a wisdom colophon and should be separate. The samekh after local Hos.14.7 makes local Hos.14.8 a possible capstone child, but the present evidence does not justify a one-verse orphan unit.
required_focus_audit.recommendation: Use Hos.14.4-Hos.14.8 and Hos.14.9; retain the speaker and verbal-force question in Hos.14.8 as meaning-only.

recommended_final_hold_questions.question: Does the ransom/death taunt at Hos.13.14 close an internal movement before Hos.13.15, or does the judgment sequence remain continuous?
recommended_final_hold_questions.current_route_effect: Keep the larger Hos.13.12-Hos.13.16 unit; do not activate the Hos.13.14|Hos.13.15 seam.
recommended_final_hold_questions.needed_evidence: Pinned broader textual, syntactic, and punctuation comparison.

recommended_final_hold_questions.question: How should the restoration clauses and temporal syntax be related across the pe after Hos.6.11?
recommended_final_hold_questions.current_route_effect: The Hos.6.11|Hos.7.1 boundary stands, with mandatory cross-boundary hydration and no final meaning ruling.
recommended_final_hold_questions.needed_evidence: Pinned syntax-oriented analysis and, if authorized, independent textual/versional evidence.

recommended_final_hold_questions.question: Who is identified as the watchman or prophet, and how do the accusation voices relate?
recommended_final_hold_questions.current_route_effect: No boundary change; Hos.9.7-Hos.9.9 remains intact.

recommended_final_hold_questions.question: Who speaks in Hos.14.8, and what is the force of its disputed verbal forms?
recommended_final_hold_questions.current_route_effect: No boundary change; Hos.14.8 remains the capstone of Hos.14.4-Hos.14.8, hydrated at the internal samekh after Hos.14.7.

recommended_final_hold_questions.question: Will every downstream route preserve exact local and MT coordinates at all three Hosea numbering offsets?
recommended_final_hold_questions.current_route_effect: Block portable alternate-numbering activation unless the unit-level crosswalk is bound and validated.
recommended_final_hold_questions.needed_evidence: Deterministic local-to-MT export validation over all 197 references.

recommended_final_hold_questions.question: How should the Judah clause in local Hos.11.12 be construed relative to Hos.12.1?
recommended_final_hold_questions.current_route_effect: No change to the accepted local Hos.12.1|Hos.12.2 rib-formula seam.

peer_conclusion.baseline_assessment: The baseline is serviceable but too coarse at nine accepted corrective seams and uniquely over-splits Hos.8.7|Hos.8.8.
peer_conclusion.primary_assessment: The Hebrew-textual primary supplies the most reliable coordinate discipline. Literary and canonical arguments materially improve several discourse seams, but literary MT export is invalid at four spans and canonical export remains local-only.
final_route_holds: Hos.13.12-Hos.13.16 internal relation and possible Hos.13.14|Hos.13.15 child seam
Hos.6.11-Hos.7.2 cross-boundary syntax and temporal relation
peer_conclusion.activation_blocker: Do not activate a portable route until the exact 197-reference local-to-MT crosswalk and all unit mt_span values pass deterministic validation.
